notes.note: This day was published, in one volume, 12mo. price 3s. bound in red leather, a new, enlarged, and corrected edition, of the late Charles Jones's Hoyle's Games Improved...Of whom may be had, separate from the above work, and ornamented with a copper-plate, price 1s. sewed, Mr. Dew's Treatise on Billiards. N. B. Ladies and gentlemean wishing to purchase the above-mentioned work, are requested to give particular directions for "Charles Jones's Hoyle's Games Improved," lest any spurious or inferior edition should be offered them.
